'''''VICTORY''''' was the name of a [[Propaganda/Legends|propaganda]] [[Painting/Legends|poster]] produced by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a series of conflicts between the Empire and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. It depicted [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] with vertical lettering down his body. The text was in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]], the [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]] [[Writing/Legends|alphabet]], and read "Victory Through Conform."<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
''VICTORY'' appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. It was a rare loot drop from fallen [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] enemies in the game. When the ''New Game Enhancements'' were released in [[November]] [[2005]], the poster was no longer obtainable, turning it into a valuable collectors item. The poster could be used in one of the player's personal structures as decoration.<ref name="SWG" />
